grounding.states: Lionel Messi is my pick for GOAT
Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina

value.answer: Messi, for me. He won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina, and he was the best player in the world for well over a decade. Maradona and Pelé have strong cases too, but Messi's record across club and country is hard to beat. I can't check current news right now, but this pick doesn't hang on anything from this week.
